hero.title:
Understand 
Elections
hero.subtitle: Learn how elections work in India—simple and clear.

howVotingWorks.title: How Voting Works
points: You vote using an Electronic Voting Machine (EVM)

isVotingSafe.title: Is Voting Safe?
points: No one knows who you voted for

items.question: Can I vote from anywhere?
items.answer: No, you must vote at your assigned polling booth. You can find your booth location using the 'Find Polling Booth' feature on the ECI website.

items.question: Can I vote without voter ID?
items.answer: Yes, if your name is in the voter list, you can vote using any other valid ID like Aadhaar, PAN card, Passport, or Driving License.

items.question: What if I don’t vote?
items.answer: You lose your chance to participate in democracy and have a say in who leads your government. Every vote matters for the future of your country.

takeaway.title: Final Takeaway
points: Elections are how people choose their leaders
